description: DSAIL helps users turn already-decided policy criteria into formal rules, review and approve exact revisions, and check extracted facts against them. Results identify which assertions hold, fail, lack facts or contain contradictory evidence, with counterexamples where available. Users can save and share rulesets in private team workspaces, manage unit conversions, inspect checking allowance and issue API keys for their own integrations. DSAIL does not decide policy or extract facts from documents itself.

defaultPrompt: Turn our expense policy into rules a program can check.
Check these extracted values against our written policy and tell me which rule decided.
Encode this checklist so every reviewer gets the same answer every time.
